bio.text: Dan Sullivan was sworn in as Alaska's U.S. Senator on January 6, 2015.

Before the Senate he served as Alaska's Attorney General and as Commissioner of the Alaska Department of Natural Resources, and earlier held posts in the George W. Bush administration, including Assistant Secretary of State for Economic, Energy and Business Affairs.
He served 30 years in the U.S. Marine Corps, retiring as a Colonel in the Marine Corps Reserve on February 1, 2024.
Sullivan earned a B.A. in Economics from Harvard University in 1987 and a joint law and M.S. in Foreign Service degree from Georgetown University in 1993.
